title: Flaky: test_unverified_certification_is_not_drafted
description: Failed once in a full suite run (1 failed, 820 passed, 14 skipped) on 2026-10-22 at tests/migrate/test_drafts.py:318, the gpg --check-sigs assertion (cora == ['-']). Passed 3/3 in isolation. Likely gpg agent/keyboxd contention under load in the fresh homedir. Find the cause; do not weaken the assertion.
notes: Root cause: gpg --faked-system-time without '!' keeps a running clock offset in whole seconds (timewarp = faked - time(NULL)). A keygen 'at T0' that crosses a real-second boundary in its first ms is stamped T0+1; the fresh home then imports at T0, rejects cora's self-sig as created in the future, skips her key, and lists her sig on ivan as '?' (observed: assert ['?'] == ['-']). Same cause can break any fixture step at T0 after a T0+1 key (e.g. nell --quick-add-uid: 'signing failed: Time conflict'), in test_drafts and conftest pgpkeys. Repro: PATH wrapper for gpg that sleeps until 2ms before a second boundary on rsa2048 keygen -> fails 2/3; on every --quick-gen-key -> fixture errors. Fix: freeze the clock (at + '!') in Gpg.__call__, Gpg.revoke_subkey (tests/migrate/conftest.py) and _edit_key (test_drafts.py), as git-vouch-migrate already does. Assertion unchanged. After: both wrappers pass 6/6, full tests/migrate under all-keygen wrapper 102 passed, 18 parallel runs pass, 3.12 and 3.9 102 passed, ruff clean.
